notebooks.neqsim_version: 3.18.0 Python bridge target with Java runtime compiled from current equinor/neqsim master
notebooks.neqsim_source_build_method: Offline javac source overlay on the v3.18.0 release dependency bundle; all master Java sources compiled except two unchanged Colt-dependent parameter-fitting sources, and the only production-code delta after v3.18.0 was included.
notebooks.execution_method: Executed all 38 code cells sequentially from an empty Python namespace with a clean local sequential executor, NEQSIM_SOURCE_ROOT fixed to the recorded master commit, and NEQSIM_SOURCE_JAR fixed to the recorded source-overlay runtime. The run retained all result-bearing outputs and ten PNG figures and produced zero stored errors and zero stderr streams.
neqsim_capabilities_demonstrated: SRK three-phase flashes for HEFA, ATJ, upgraded fast-pyrolysis oil, and upgraded HTL biocrude surrogates
wet-syngas condensation and one-stage versus three-stage compression with intercooling
ASTM D86, D4052, D445, and D1322 oil-quality calculations for upgraded-oil TBP surrogates

checks: feedstock compositions and route mass balances close
HEFA, ATJ, pyrolysis, and HTL surrogate flashes produce expected phases
wet syngas condenses an aqueous phase

rendered_visual_validation.renderer: Pandoc 3.1.3 standalone HTML with MathML plus pdfLaTeX display-equation rendering and original-resolution PNG inspection
rendered_visual_validation.notes: Every retained figure was inspected at original resolution for labels, units, legends, contrast, clipping, and consistency with stored results. All display equations were rendered and inspected across two pages.

notebooks.documentation_impact: The main NeqSim-Colab examples catalog is updated with a direct relative link and a concise scope description. No public NeqSim API, default, or installation interface is changed.
notebooks.issue_handling: No NeqSim defect invalidating the study was found. ASTM D445 returns non-finite viscosity for the deliberately sparse teaching TBP surrogates; the notebook converts this to a documented missing assay requirement rather than presenting a false viscosity result.
